title: Space kid shows copper bracelet worn in channeling sessions

tellings.quote: She whipped out this bracelet she had that was like a copper a little copper plate on this bracelet that she said like they all had to wear when they were doing their channeling sessions with him decades later.

plain: Greg Malatzi, a researcher, says that a few years ago he filmed an interview with a woman who, as a child in the 1970s, took part in channeling sessions, attempts to receive messages from non-human beings, with a CIA scientist. He says she pulled out a bracelet with a small copper plate, and told him all the children had to wear one during the sessions. He tells it as physical proof that the sessions he describes really took place.
